module: Flowgraph node "Race Disqualify" (category repeat_instant, tag scenario). Disqualifies a vehicle from a race by calling raceData:abortRace(vehId). Inputs: raceData and vehId.
notes: work() has no guard: an empty raceData pin causes a Lua error.

work.desc: Calls abortRace(vehId) on the received race.
